verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a coverage map of supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, or local-currency settlement for connected accounts. The Connect docs cited cover onboarding flows, payouts and balances generically, not geographic or currency coverage. Community remarks about international availability are anecdotal and old, and are not a first-party coverage map, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a founder, sellers can join from where they are — supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, and local-currency settlement documented as a coverage map, not discovered ticket by ticket
